component.name: Mocktail
component.summary: Experimental Roblox Android compatibility runtime for Linux

description.p: Mocktail is an experimental compatibility runtime for running the Android x86-64 Roblox client on a native Linux desktop. It provides the pseudo-JVM, Android ABI adapters, SDL window/input/audio integration and Vulkan presentation needed by the client.
The project is a prototype and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Roblox Corporation. The verified Roblox payload is downloaded on first launch and is not distributed with Mocktail.
